bullets: On Thursday 15 October, Dubai recorded 538 sales worth AED 1.8bn, which was 15.1 percent above a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 62.8 percent of Thursday's sales.
The median price was AED 1584 per square foot, down 4.2 percent compared to the 30-day average.
Over the last seven days, Dubai South led transactions with 318 sales, followed by JVC with 202 and Downtown Jebel Ali with 152.
In September new rental contracts, a JVC 1-bedroom apartment had a median price of AED 69,000 a year, up 3.2 percent on the month.
talking_points: UAE real estate transactions surged 103 percent, which signals exceptional overall market health and investor appetite.
Dubai's property sector hit $3.7bn in weekly deals, showing strong weekly transaction volume and high-value luxury sales.
Prime Dubai rents dropped while suburban rates climbed, which shifts rental affordability dynamics across different city sectors.
